entities.summary: Victor Olofsson is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a left winger for the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL). Olofsson was selected by the Buffalo Sabres in the 7th round, 181st overall, in the 2014 NHL entry draft, and has also played for the Vegas Golden Knights and Colorado Avalanche. He is the younger brother of Jesper Olofsson, also a professional ice hockey player.
